speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly how the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started, and have you had any recent injuries or insect bites?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That mechanism suggests a significant tensile force. Do you have any difficulty flexing or extending the tip of the finger, and can you feel any numbness or tingling?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: This clinical picture is highly suggestive of a distal flexor tendon avulsion fracture, commonly known as a "Jersey Finger." I need to confirm if you can actively flex the tip of your finger against resistance, or if it remains stuck in extension. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_hand
